answer_text:
We need the smallest prime \(p>3\) that cannot be written as

\[
|3^a-2^b|
\]

with non-negative integers \(a,b\).

First check the primes \(>3\) smaller than \(41\):

\[
\begin{aligned}
5&=|3^1-2^3|=|3-8|,\\
7&=|3^2-2^1|=|9-2|,\\
11&=|3^3-2^4|=|27-16|,\\
13&=|3^1-2^4|=|3-16|,\\
17&=|3^4-2^6|=|81-64|,\\
19&=|3^3-2^3|=|27-8|,\\
23&=|3^2-2^5|=|9-32|,\\
29&=|3^1-2^5|=|3-32|,\\
31&=|3^0-2^5|=|1-32|,\\
37&=|3^3-2^6|=|27-64|.
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus every prime \(p>3\) with \(p<41\) is representable.

Now show that \(41\) is not representable. Suppose

\[
|3^a-2^b|=41.
\]

There are two cases.

### Case 1: \(2^b-3^a=41\)

If \(b=0,1,2\), then the left side is at most \(3\), impossible.  
So \(b\ge 3\).

Modulo \(8\),

\[
2^b-3^a\equiv -3^a\pmod 8,
\]

and \(41\equiv 1\pmod 8\). Hence

\[
3^a\equiv 7\pmod 8.
\]

But powers of \(3\) modulo \(8\) are only \(1\) and \(3\), so this is impossible.

### Case 2: \(3^a-2^b=41\)

If \(b=0,1,2\), then

\[
3^a=42,43,45,
\]

none of which is a power of \(3\). So \(b\ge 3\).

Modulo \(8\),

\[
3^a-2^b\equiv 3^a\equiv 41\equiv 1\pmod 8,
\]

so \(a\) is even. Also \(a\neq 0\), since \(1-2^b\neq 41\). Thus \(a\ge 2\).

Now reduce modulo \(9\). Since \(a\ge 2\),

\[
3^a\equiv 0\pmod 9.
\]

Because \(41\equiv 5\pmod 9\),

\[
-2^b\equiv 5\pmod 9,
\]

so

\[
2^b\equiv 4\pmod 9.
\]

The powers of \(2\) modulo \(9\) cycle with period \(6\):

\[
2,4,8,7,5,1,
\]

so \(2^b\equiv 4\pmod 9\) implies

\[
b\equiv 2\pmod 6.
\]

Now reduce modulo \(7\). Since \(b\equiv 2\pmod 6\), we have \(b\equiv 2\pmod 3\), and because \(2^3\equiv 1\pmod 7\),

\[
2^b\equiv 2^2\equiv 4\pmod 7.
\]

Also \(a\) is even, so modulo \(6\), \(a\equiv 0,2,\) or \(4\). Since \(3^6\equiv 1\pmod 7\),

\[
3^a\equiv 1,2,\text{ or }4\pmod 7.
\]

But from \(3^a-2^b=41\) and \(41\equiv 6\pmod 7\),

\[
3^a-4\equiv 6\pmod 7,
\]

so

\[
3^a\equiv 3\pmod 7,
\]

which is impossible because \(a\) is even.

Therefore no non-negative integers \(a,b\) satisfy \(|3^a-2^b|=41\).

Hence the smallest such prime is

\[
\boxed{41}
\]
